description: The Jira / Azure DevOps integration configuration of the active SimplifyQA project. action "status" (call first): which credentials are set, active project, discovery, existing configuration, pending save. action "apply" (mappings): save YOUR mapping proposal into the configuration the Marketplace screen edits, after validating it against the discovered metadata (known modules, types and fields; one module per type; each field once; convertible types; required external fields mapped or acknowledged with the user's reason). action "delete" (tool): delete the whole configuration (connection and every mapping) like the screen's delete; synced records stay; to remove only some modules use apply with type null. action "setup" (tool): when credentials are missing or the user wants to change tokens, open a terminal window on the user's computer where THEY type the tokens (hidden); never ask for tokens in chat. action "prepare" (prepare): create what the mapping needs in SimplifyQA — custom fields (TEXT or LIST), list values, releases and sprints; existing ones are reused and close matches are listed as suggestions; run integration_lookup fields first. action "webhook": check that Jira (webhook) or Azure DevOps (service hooks) sends changes to SimplifyQA and register it if missing (needs a Jira admin token, or an Azure project administrator PAT with the Service Hooks scope; otherwise it returns the manual steps). apply, delete, prepare and webhook take TWO STEPS: call WITHOUT confirmToken for a preview and a confirm token (nothing changes); show it to the user; only after the user explicitly agrees, call again with the SAME arguments and the confirmToken.

acknowledge.description: apply: the user's reason for saving with required external fields unmapped

mappings.description: action "apply": only the modules to change; modules not listed keep their current mapping

fields.description: The COMPLETE field list for this module: pairs left out are removed from the saved mapping

default.description: Value SimplifyQA uses when the external value is missing (needed for mandatory fields with no external counterpart). Lists: option key or label; release / sprint / user / linked record: name or id; dates: YYYY-MM-DD

extField.description: Jira / Azure DevOps field key or name; omit for a default-only field

type.description: Jira issue type / Azure DevOps work item type name; null removes this module from the integration

prepare.description: action "prepare": what to create in SimplifyQA

customFields.description: SimplifyQA custom fields to add. When the user asks for a Jira / Azure DevOps field that has no SimplifyQA counterpart, pass fromField and the field is created to match it

fromField.description: Jira / Azure DevOps field key or name to copy: label, type (LIST with its values, else TEXT) and values come from it

ensureReleaseSprint.description: If the SimplifyQA project has no release or no sprint, create "Release 1" / "Sprint 1"; existing ones are reported. Use them as the Release / Sprint defaults in apply

listValues.description: Options to add to SimplifyQA list fields (e.g. Jira statuses or priorities missing in SimplifyQA)

field.description: SimplifyQA list field key or label, e.g. state

releases.description: Release names (created for 30 days from today if missing)

sprints.description: Sprints and their release (created for 14 days from today if missing)

name: integration_config
title: Integration configuration
